description: Use this when you need the number of working days between two dates. Example prompt: "How many working days are there between 1 March and 30 April 2027?" Count working days (Mon-Fri) between two dates inclusive, optionally excluding Dutch public holidays. Exact date math for SLA, payroll, and planning questions. Costs 1 credit. The answer is deterministic.

excludeDutchHolidays.description: Skip Dutch public holidays that fall on a weekday (default true)

name: working_days_between

result.description: The result, when it is not an object

title: Working Days Calculator
